title: Efficacy of MitraCLip Vs. PASCAL for the TrEAtment of MitraL REgurgiTation in an All-comer Population
official: Efficacy of Mitraclip Vs. PASCAL for the Treatment of Mitral Regurgitation in an All-comer Population
summary: To investigate potential differences in procedural outcomes of both commercially available transcatheter edge-to-edge mitral valve repair devices in a non-selected clinical setting.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age equal or above 18 years
* Written consent
* Heart Team recommends M-TEER

Exclusion Criteria:

* Mitral Stenosis (MV mean PG \> 5 mmHg)
* Cardiogenic shock or hemodynamic instability at the time of intervention
* Active endocarditis
* Participant in another interventional cardiology study
